generators.carrier: exact 2-mode Fock space, dimension 4 over exact rationals/Gaussian rationals

relations.statement: Parity P=diag(1,-1,-1,1) has +1 eigenspace span{|00>,|11>} of dimension 2 and -1 eigenspace span{|01>,|10>} of dimension 2; the sectors are orthogonal and sum to dimension 4.
relations.hypotheses: Basis ordering |n1 n2>, parity = (-1)^(n1+n2), exact arithmetic.

relations.statement: Restriction of an operator A to a sector S is defined only if A S is contained in S, i.e. A commutes with P.
relations.hypotheses: P is a self-adjoint involution; sectors are its eigenspaces.

lemmas.statement: For the 2-mode Fock carrier truncated to occupation 0 or 1 per mode, P has even and odd eigenspaces each of dimension 2.
gamma_1 maps even to odd sector, so [gamma_1,P]≠0 and its restriction to a sector is refused.

near_misses.claim: Restricting an even operator such as a number-conserving operator to a sector is allowed and well-defined.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: This is not a counterexample; it only succeeds because the operator commutes with P, unlike gamma_1.
Trace of P is 0 so even and odd dimensions are equal, 2 and 2.
